question: How do I work with trip activities?

sections.title: Open personal trip activities
items: Plantour opens your personal trip activities for the currently selected trip.
sections.afterHtml: If the wrong trip opens, select the correct trip first and then return to the activity page.

sections.title: Add, update, or delete activities
items: On the personal activities page, you can add, update, or delete your own trip activities.
An activity can include a name, activity type, dates, address, optional coordinates, notes, and an itinerary part link.

sections.title: Connect activities to itinerary parts
items: Use the itinerary part selector in the activity form when you want to attach the activity to one itinerary part.
In the activity list, Plantour can show or hide itinerary part selectors by using the page menu option Show Itinerary Parts or Hide Itinerary Parts.
When itinerary parts are visible, you can reassign an activity to a different itinerary part directly from the list.
This helps keep the activity plan aligned with the trip route and timing.

sections.title: Use activities on the map and in Google Maps directions
items: Open Map from the Dashboard`s Trip section when you want to see itinerary parts and your activities together on one map.
Activities with valid coordinates or a geocodable address can be shown on the map and included in visible activity paths.
Use the path controls on the map page to show or hide itinerary and activity paths before sending directions.
Use Get directions on the map page when you want Plantour to send the currently visible itinerary and activity route points to Google Maps.

sections.title: Review and narrow the activity lists
items: Use Filter by Name when you want to narrow the list by activity name.
Use the Activity filter when you want to show only one activity type.
Use Sort by Name if you want the list alphabetically.
Activity rows can show schedule, address, itinerary-part link, and activity type so you can review the plan quickly.
